Here is the head-to-head:

| | **A - Ottervale Audio** | **B - Brackmoor Sound** |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |

| **Price** | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| **Rating** | **4.8 out of 5 (1,900 reviews)** | 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews) |
| **Shipping** | In stock. Free standard, 3-5 business days | In stock. Free standard, 3-5 business days |
| **Returns** | 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping | 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping |
| **Warranty** | 1-year limited | 1-year limited |
| **Specs** | Identical - ANC with transparency, 40h battery, USB-C fast charge, Bluetooth 5.3 with 2-device pairing, 254g, graphite, with case + USB-C + 3.5mm cable | Identical |

**Why A is the better choice:**

1.  **Same product, same price, same policies** - There is no price, shipping, warranty, or spec advantage to either seller.

Since everything else is equal, the lower-risk seller is Ottervale Audio - link A.
